neighbours.label: a preposition in an odd or unusual slot right after a verb or modal: ' of' in 'should of course' and 'comprise of', Arabic ' في' after a verb, sentence-initial 'Remove with'
fire: Every driver should of course wear a seat belt.
The exam will consist of and comprise of two parts.
ما يمكن أن يحدث في المدينة كبير.
Clean with a soft cloth and warm water.
Parents must of course sign the forms.
The course will comprise of nine lectures.
لا يوجد سوى في هذا البلد.
Wash with cold water, then dry flat.
quiet: A bottle of water sits on the table by the door.
Two parts of the exam were hard this year.
A piece of soft cloth lay near the warm stove.
Parents of young children signed the forms.
Nine lectures of the course are on Mondays.
طلاب في هذا البلد يدرسون كثيرا.
A cup of cold milk stood on the flat rock.

notes: Card: broad (2.6%), 52% L; ' في' x9, ' of' x6, ' as' x4, ' may' x2, '"a', ' with'. Probe: ' of' after 'should' 0.894; ' في' 0.698 and 0.381; ' of' after 'comprise' 0.673; ' with' after 'Remove' 0.576; the same sentences without it 0.087 at most. Near misses use ' of' and ' في' in the ordinary slot after a noun, which is the real test of 'odd slot'.
